name: AIR-Bench (Audio Instruction Benchmark)
description: The first benchmark designed to evaluate Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) on generative comprehension across speech, natural sounds, and music. Consists of two components: a Foundation benchmark with 19 tasks and ~19,000 single-choice questions, and a Chat benchmark with ~2,000 open-ended QA instances. Uses GPT-4-based scoring of generated responses validated against human judgments.
evaluation_method: GPT-4 consistency score for chat tasks; accuracy for foundation tasks
reputation: Published at ACL 2024; first benchmark targeting generative audio comprehension rather than isolated ASR; code and data publicly available
notes: Distinct from AIR-Bench 2024 safety benchmark (Stanford CRFM). Focuses on audio-language model evaluation. GitHub: github.com/OFA-Sys/AIR-Bench
